$comment: Canonical catalog of the Stations of the Cross. The bundle now ships two VARIANTS (devotion.json variants[]): 'traditional' (this file's 14 stations, Liguori meditations in la/en, scriptural meditations in he) and 'scriptural' (the 1991 St. John Paul II scriptural Way of the Cross, keys scriptural01*–scriptural14*, la/en/he). Both close with the Closing Prayer + Anima Christi (a hardcoded main-prayer key). imageKey doubles as the filename stem under Shared/Images/{imageKey}. Source of truth: Shared/content/stationsOfTheCross/. Keep in sync — see README.md in this directory.

images.note: All 14 stations: Gebhard Fugel (1863-1939), Kreuzweg (1921), St. Antonius, Bad Saulgau — public domain; photographs by Andreas Praefcke, released into the public domain. Shipped inside the bundle; see Shared/Images/CREDITS.md.

languages.note: la/en carry the Liguori meditations; he (user-provided, Hebrew-Catholic usage) carries scriptural meditations instead — Isaiah/Judith citations plus Delitzsch NT passages, its own opening meditation + blessing, and a closing sequence of closing prayer + Anima Christi + concluding blessing. Other languages fall back to the bundle's Latin via resolveBodyText.
